name: CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel (thymic carcinoma)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic platinum/taxane backbone, not biomarker-restricted. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas v2.2026, THYM-C, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel is a listed first-line regimen for thymic carcinoma.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for advanced (unresectable, metastatic, or recurrent) thymic carcinoma; also an option for thymoma

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: thymic carcinoma (also an option for thymoma)
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026 (04/10/26), THYM-C Systemic Therapy Regimens, line 635 (Carboplatin/Paclitaxel, thymic carcinoma column, references 2 and 3)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas
provenance.locator: THYM-C Systemic Therapy Regimens, line 635 (Carboplatin/Paclitaxel listed as a first-line regimen; NCCN does not print the target AUC)

drugs.notes: VERIFY: The regimen (carboplatin plus paclitaxel for thymic carcinoma) is established in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) THYM-C (line 635) and Harrison 22nd ed. (line 91257), but NONE of the provided sources print a carboplatin target AUC. Target AUC must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source before this field is set. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas
provenance.locator: THYM-C Systemic Therapy Regimens, line 635 (Carboplatin/Paclitaxel; NCCN does not print the paclitaxel dose)

drugs.notes: VERIFY: Paclitaxel mg/m2 dose is not printed in any provided source (NCCN THYM-C lists the regimen name only; DeVita line 77676 and Harrison line 91257 describe the ECOG carboplatin/paclitaxel experience in thymic carcinoma without doses). Requires corticosteroid/antihistamine premedication once the dose is grounded. Tall-man per ISMP.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine per paclitaxel labeling (apply once the dose/schedule is grounded).

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: carboplatin/paclitaxel is moderate emetic risk (apply tier once schedule confirmed).

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 77676 (ECOG prospective trial of carboplatin plus paclitaxel in thymoma and thymic carcinoma; ORR 33% thymoma, 24% thymic carcinoma; line 77678, Japanese study in thymic carcinoma ORR 36%); Harrison 22nd ed. line 91257 (carboplatin and paclitaxel often employed in thymic carcinoma). None of these state the doses.

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas
guideline.locator: THYM-C Principles of Systemic Therapy, Systemic Therapy Regimens, line 635: Carboplatin/Paclitaxel listed as a first-line regimen for thymic carcinoma (references 2 and 3). NCCN lists the regimen but does not print doses.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel in thymic carcinoma. The regimen, setting, and first-line role are grounded in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Thymomas and Thymic Carcinomas v2.2026 (THYM-C, line 635) and Harrison 22nd ed. (line 91257), and DeVita 12th ed. (lines 77676 to 77678) describes the ECOG and Japanese carboplatin/paclitaxel thymic-carcinoma experience. However, NONE of the provided sources print the carboplatin target AUC, the paclitaxel mg/m2 dose, the cycle length, or the number of cycles, so those four fields are the literal VERIFY (never invented) and are listed in verifyFields; per the schema this blocks status ACTIVE. ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
